correctness.rationale: Expanding the full Haar orthogonal forward-difference estimator on f=λ||x||²/2 gives exactly X_{n+1}=(1−γ)X_n−(γδ√d/2)V_n with independent uniform sphere directions. The contractive affine recursion yields its unique invariant via an absolutely convergent random series and W₂ contraction |1−γ|; independence yields E||X||²=dγδ²/[4(2−γ)]. In dimension d≥2, planar polygon lengths and connectedness of the product of sphere directions show its complete support is r≤||x||≤R, with R=a/(1−q), r=R max(0,1−2q), q=|1−γ|. The two-sphere addition map is a submersion away from parallel directions, proving absolute continuity for q>0; at γ=1 one uniform sphere remains. Exact independent rational checks of 21 endpoint/moment examples corroborate formulas, but the all-parameter conclusion follows from the geometric proof. Boundaries γ=0,2 and dimension 1 excluded.
